entry.name: timepoint
entry.description: Outputs a bang when the clock reaches a specific time. The clock has to be moving forward in order for the bang to be output.

arguments.name: time
arguments.description: Sets the initial time at which to send a bang. Time can be specified in any of theused in Max. The bang will only be sent when the transport is running.
